integrity: Complete analytic Laplace-transform calculation and independent binomial-counting proof; checker performs finite exact arithmetic, geometry, and numerical quadrature only. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp coefficient and distribution statements concern only the standard unit three-dimensional cross-polytope and integer frequencies/translations; boundaries of translated octahedra are excluded from pointwise multiplicity claims. Older equivalent specialized calculations remain possible.
title: Octahedral lattice Fourier support and exact three-level covering multiplicities
